in_marathi.name: Kshirjsha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kshirjsha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kshirjsha is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is the name of a goddess who embodies the essence of love, fertility, and prosperity. She is believed to bring wealth and happiness to her devotees. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted with a pot of rice or kshir, symbolizing abundance and nourishment.
